title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
description: We introduce DRBench Pro, which uses Wikipedia-derived knowledge trees to define research tasks and their evaluation criteria within a shared reference space. The tree structure separates major research directions from chains of related knowledge within them, enabling distinct measures of breadth and depth.
author: XLCYun

images.caption: Overview of DRBench Pro. (A) We construct a Wikipedia-derived local graph around a selected root entity and sample subgraphs by retaining selected children of the root and their complete descendant subtrees together with the root. (B1) Each sampled subgraph defines a research query. (B2) Each sampled edge is converted into an edge-grounded rubric, forming the hidden rubric set. (C) An evaluated deep research agent answers the query with a report; a judge scores the report against the rubric set, and the edge-level scores are mapped back to the local knowledge tree and aggregated bottom-up into breadth and depth.
